column2: a sunny city park in late spring: a wide paved path, green lawns, blooming trees and flower beds on both sides, a park bench and a lamppost at the side, a fountain far in the distance

a cosy winter Christmas fair on a town square in the evening: snow on the ground, wooden market stalls with warm string lights on both sides, a decorated fir tree far in the background, soft falling snow
inside a charming cosy cafe: small round tables with flowers at the sides, a pastry display counter in the background, big windows with warm daylight, potted plants, wooden floor
a sunny sandy beach: turquoise sea and gentle waves in the background, a striped beach umbrella and a sun lounger at one side, palm leaves at the other edge, clear sky
a friend's apartment house party at night: neon pink and violet lights, a disco ball, balloons and garlands on the walls, a sofa at the side, a glossy floor
a seaside resort restaurant terrace at sunset: a wooden deck, lanterns and string lights, potted palms on the sides, the calm sea and a pink-orange sunset sky in the background
a modern bright office lobby: glass walls, a reception desk at the side, tall plants, city skyscrapers through big windows in the background, polished light floor
a grand theatre foyer before a premiere: red velvet curtains and drapes, golden balconies and a crystal chandelier, a red carpet on a marble floor
a modern art gallery opening: white walls with large colourful abstract paintings at the sides, spotlights, a sculpture on a plinth, a polished concrete floor, soft evening glow
a luxurious palace ballroom: marble columns, huge crystal chandeliers, tall arched windows with night sky, gold ornaments, a shiny parquet floor
a bright city riverside running track on a sunny morning: a finish-line arch with colourful flags (no text), green trees, the river and city bridge in the background
